products.name: Cookies
products.description: Discover your new favorite treat with our delicious selection of freshly baked cookies! From classic Chocolate Chip and creamy White Chocolate Chip to comforting Oatmeal and rich Double Chocolate, there's a perfect flavor for every craving. Each cookie is baked with love, featuring irresistible flavors and a soft, chewy texture that makes every bite extra special. Whether you're in the mood for something sweet, chocolatey, or delightfully comforting, our cookies are the perfect treat to enjoy anytime. Freshly baked, full of flavor, and made to sweeten your day!

products.name: Cheesecake
products.description: Indulge in the creamy, dreamy goodness of our classic Cheesecake! Made with a rich, velvety-smooth filling and a buttery graham cracker crust, every slice delivers the perfect balance of sweetness and a melt-in-your-mouth texture. Smooth, decadent, and irresistibly delicious, our cheesecake is lovingly crafted to satisfy your sweet cravings and make every occasion a little more special. Whether you're celebrating a special moment or treating yourself to something sweet, this timeless favorite is always a perfect choice!

products.name: Flan / Quesillo
products.description: Treat yourself to the creamy, melt-in-your-mouth goodness of our Flan, also known as Quesillo! This classic dessert features a smooth, silky custard with a rich, delicate sweetness, topped with a luscious golden caramel sauce that adds the perfect touch of indulgence. Every spoonful is a delicious blend of creamy texture and sweet caramel flavor, lovingly made to bring a little extra sweetness to your day. A timeless favorite that makes every occasion feel special!

products.name: Tres Leches Cake
products.description: Indulge in the irresistible sweetness of our Tres Leches Cake, a soft, fluffy sponge cake delicately soaked in a rich blend of three milks for the perfect melt-in-your-mouth experience. Topped with a light, creamy whipped topping, every bite is a dreamy balance of sweetness, moisture, and pure delight. Made with love and crafted to make every occasion extra special, this classic Latin dessert is a little slice of heaven!

products.name: Mini Chocoflan
products.description: Big flavor comes in a little package with our delicious Mini Chocoflan! This irresistible individual-sized treat combines a rich, moist chocolate cake with a silky, creamy flan, finished with a luscious layer of golden caramel. Every bite is the perfect harmony of chocolatey goodness, smooth custard, and sweet caramel. Beautifully layered and made with love, our Mini Chocoflan is perfect for satisfying your sweet cravings, sharing with someone special, or enjoying a little moment of indulgence all to yourself. Small, sweet, and absolutely unforgettable!

products.name: Brownies Bites
products.description: Bite into pure chocolate bliss with our delicious Brownie Bites! These irresistible little treats are rich, fudgy, and packed with decadent chocolate flavor, featuring a soft, chewy center and a perfectly baked exterior. Each bite is the perfect balance of sweetness and indulgence, making them ideal for sharing, gifting, or treating yourself to a little moment of happiness. Small in size, big on flavor, and always made with love!

products.name: Chocoflan
products.description: The best of both worlds come together in our irresistible Chocoflan! This decadent dessert combines a rich, moist chocolate cake with a smooth, creamy flan, all topped with a luscious layer of golden caramel. Each bite offers the perfect balance of deep chocolate flavor, silky custard, and sweet caramel goodness. Beautifully layered and made with love, our Chocoflan is a show-stopping treat that's perfect for celebrations, special occasions, or simply satisfying your sweet tooth. One slice is never enough!

seasonal_collections.description: Celebrate the season with handmade desserts.
